elvis-presley-debut-album.research_focus: 1956 record shops and home hi-fi, RCA Victor 12-inch LPs, Memphis-era listening rooms
elvis-presley-debut-album.scene: A teenager's bedroom in the 1950s with a portable record player, its lid open and a long-playing record spinning, a stack of sleeves on the floor beside a dancing pair of saddle shoes. No faces.

miles-davis-kind-of-blue.research_focus: Columbia's 30th Street Studio in New York, 1959, a converted church with a high ceiling, microphones and a jazz sextet's instruments
miles-davis-kind-of-blue.scene: An empty converted-church recording studio at night, a trumpet with a mute lying across a chair beside a piano and a standing bass, a single microphone on a boom stand in the dim light.

dylan-freewheelin-album.research_focus: Greenwich Village in early 1960s winter, folk clubs, a battered acoustic guitar and harmonica rack
dylan-freewheelin-album.scene: A snowy Greenwich Village side street, a couple walking arm in arm seen from behind, a worn acoustic guitar case slung over one shoulder and a coffeehouse window glowing beside them.

beach-boys-pet-sounds.research_focus: Hollywood studio sessions in 1966 with orchestral instruments, bicycle horn, harpsichord and barking dogs on tape
beach-boys-pet-sounds.scene: A crowded Los Angeles recording studio floor with a harpsichord, a bicycle horn, a theremin and a cluster of orchestral stands, sunlight from a high window and a pair of small dogs sitting by the mixing desk.

beatles-sgt-pepper.research_focus: Abbey Road Studio Two in 1967, four-track tape machines, a brass band bandstand, a collage of cardboard cut-outs and flowers
beatles-sgt-pepper.scene: A crowded collage of life-size cardboard cut-outs and wax figures standing behind a flowerbed shaped like a guitar, a bass drum with a painted fairground face lying on the grass in front. No real faces recognisable.

beatles-abbey-road.research_focus: Abbey Road in St John's Wood, London, the zebra crossing, a white Volkswagen Beetle parked, the 1969 streetscape
beatles-abbey-road.scene: A leafy London street with a zebra crossing, a parked Volkswagen Beetle and a stucco-fronted studio building behind a low wall, four sets of footprints-sized shadows stretched across the stripes, no people.

led-zeppelin-iv-album.research_focus: Headley Grange, a Victorian workhouse in Hampshire used for rock recording, a stairwell used as a drum room, a mobile studio
led-zeppelin-iv-album.scene: A dark Victorian country house stairwell with a drum kit set up on the landing and microphones hung down the banister, a mobile recording truck parked on gravel visible through the open door.

bowie-ziggy-stardust-album.research_focus: 1972 glam rock stage costumes, a lightning-bolt painted face motif, platform boots, a theatre stage in London
bowie-ziggy-stardust-album.scene: An empty theatre stage under a single spotlight, a mannequin wearing a quilted jumpsuit and platform boots, a lightning-bolt painted on a mirror behind it and a guitar propped against a monitor.

pink-floyd-dark-side-album.research_focus: A glass prism splitting a beam of light into a spectrum, 1970s Abbey Road studio equipment, a heartbeat and clocks as album themes
pink-floyd-dark-side-album.scene: A glass prism standing on a dark surface, a single beam of light entering one side and a rainbow spectrum spreading out the other, with a row of antique clocks and a tape reel in the shadows.

springsteen-born-to-run-album.research_focus: 1975 New Jersey Shore towns, a vintage Chevrolet, a saxophone, a Fender Telecaster, boardwalk night streets
springsteen-born-to-run-album.scene: A battered 1960s coupe parked at an empty boardwalk edge at dusk, a saxophone and a worn guitar lying across the back seat, the sea and a Ferris wheel in the distance.

eagles-hotel-california-album.research_focus: A Spanish-revival hotel in 1970s California, a desert highway at night, palm trees, twin electric guitars
eagles-hotel-california-album.scene: A Spanish-style hotel with a bell tower and an arched entrance glowing at the end of a long desert highway at night, palm trees on either side and a pair of electric guitars leaning in the lobby doorway.

fleetwood-mac-rumours-album.research_focus: Record Plant studio in Sausalito, California, 1976, mixing consoles, wine bottles and ashtrays, analogue tape reels
fleetwood-mac-rumours-album.scene: A messy 1970s recording studio lounge, a big mixing console with faders and tape reels, a half-empty wine bottle and scattered sheet music on a low table, a crumpled love letter on the floor.

pink-floyd-the-wall-album.research_focus: The Wall's stage show, a huge cardboard-brick wall built across a stadium stage, school desks, Islington Green School choir
pink-floyd-the-wall-album.scene: A great wall of cardboard bricks nearly sealing a stadium stage, a single gap left at the centre showing a lone armchair and a lamp, a row of empty school desks in front.

acdc-back-in-black-album.research_focus: Compass Point Studios in Nassau, Bahamas in 1980, a church bell and a black album sleeve, hard rock amplifiers
acdc-back-in-black-album.scene: A tropical Bahamian recording studio with a wall of Marshall amplifiers, shuttered windows open on palm trees and the sea, and a heavy brass church bell hanging in the corner.

prince-purple-rain-album.research_focus: Minneapolis' First Avenue nightclub, a motorcycle, a ruffled shirt and a purple-lit stage, 1984 rock film production
prince-purple-rain-album.scene: A Minneapolis nightclub stage with a gleaming motorcycle parked beside a piano, a rain-drenched window behind it and a ruffled jacket draped over the stool, lit in a thick stage haze.

u2-joshua-tree-album.research_focus: A Joshua tree in the desert of the American Southwest, a Dublin studio, 1987 stadium touring, desert highway
u2-joshua-tree-album.scene: A single Joshua tree standing alone on a vast desert plain at dawn, a dusty road running off to the horizon and a battered guitar leaning against the trunk.

madonna-like-a-prayer-album.research_focus: A gospel choir in robes, a church interior with candles and stained glass, a burning cross controversy, 1989 pop video imagery
madonna-like-a-prayer-album.scene: A church interior with rows of candles burning at an altar, a gospel choir in long robes singing under a stained-glass window and a pair of lace gloves and a rosary lying on a pew.

nas-illmatic-album.research_focus: Queensbridge Houses in Queens, New York, 1994 sampler and turntable setups, a boom box on a stoop
nas-illmatic-album.scene: A brick public-housing courtyard in Queens at dusk, a boom box on the steps beside a crate of vinyl records, a sampler and pair of turntables set up on a folding table.

radiohead-ok-computer-album.research_focus: St Catherine's Court in Bath, a country mansion used as a studio in 1996-97, airport lounges, early computer-voice technology
radiohead-ok-computer-album.scene: An empty airport departure lounge at night seen through a glass wall, a lone bank of computer monitors blinking, and the shape of a jet on the runway outside.

lauryn-hill-miseducation-album.research_focus: A classroom with a chalkboard and school desk, 1998 New York and Kingston studios, gospel choir, a vinyl record and a crown of braids
lauryn-hill-miseducation-album.scene: An old schoolroom with a worn wooden desk carved with names, an open notebook and a vinyl record, a chalkboard behind covered in lyrics-like scribbles, no readable words.

norah-jones-come-away-with-me-album.research_focus: A piano in a quiet 2001 New York studio, a jazz lounge, Blue Note Records, Grammy gramophone trophies
norah-jones-come-away-with-me-album.scene: An upright piano in a softly lit jazz lounge, a lamp glowing on its lid, a row of gleaming gramophone trophies lined up on top and a single coffee cup beside the keys.

amy-winehouse-back-to-black-album.research_focus: 2006 Camden Town, a retro 1960s girl-group soul sound, a beehive hairdo, a vinyl record and a brass section, Daptone Records
amy-winehouse-back-to-black-album.scene: A narrow north London pub stage with a vintage microphone on a stand, a beehive wig on a stool beside a worn leather jacket, and a brass section's trumpets propped against a speaker.

adele-21-album.research_focus: A London bedsit and a grand piano, 2011 pop radio, a vinyl record player and a stack of tissues, Grammy trophies
adele-21-album.scene: A grand piano in a rainy London room beside a tall window, crumpled tissues on the lid and a record player turning beside a stack of award gramophones.

beyonce-surprise-album.research_focus: 2013 smartphone and iTunes store, a midnight release, a stack of music videos on screens, a shipping container and a dance rehearsal studio
beyonce-surprise-album.scene: A dim dance rehearsal studio at midnight with a wall of video screens glowing, a smartphone resting on a stack of unmarked boxes and a pair of heels on the floor in front of a mirror.

kendrick-to-pimp-a-butterfly-album.research_focus: Compton in 2015, the White House lawn, a jazz and funk live band in a studio, a butterfly, a Los Angeles street scene
kendrick-to-pimp-a-butterfly-album.scene: A sunlit Compton street with a row of low houses and palm trees, a large butterfly landing on the roof of a parked low-rider and a saxophone case open on the sidewalk.

beyonce-lemonade-album.research_focus: A Louisiana plantation house, a flooded street, lemons, a baseball bat, a bathtub, a 2016 film premiere on HBO
beyonce-lemonade-album.scene: A grand Louisiana plantation house on a misty lawn, a bowl of cut lemons and a baseball bat resting on the porch steps, a flooded road curving away behind it.

billie-eilish-debut-album.research_focus: A cramped Los Angeles bedroom studio, 2019, a laptop and condenser microphone, a bed with duvet, oversized clothes
billie-eilish-debut-album.scene: A cramped teenager's bedroom turned studio, a laptop and a small condenser microphone on the bed, an oversized hoodie thrown on a chair and a pair of headphones draped over a lamp.

taylor-swift-folklore-album.research_focus: A misty forest cabin in 2020, a cardigan hanging on a hook, a piano and acoustic guitar, a woodland stream and moss-covered trees
taylor-swift-folklore-album.scene: A mossy woodland cabin among tall pine trees in the mist, a knitted cardigan hanging on a porch post beside an acoustic guitar and a half-open door glowing with lamplight.
